text_block_list.text:
All eyes are focused on Спешл Уик
and Seiun
Sky as the Kikuka Sho, the
final race of the
Classic Triple Crown, is
set to begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало grumbles to herself that the
crowd has
forgotten who the real star is
as she approaches
the paddock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
